sloka: ते तस्य कायं निर्भिद्य महाकार्मुकनिस्सृताः।निपेतुर्धरणीं बाणा रक्ता इव महोरगाः ।। ६.९१.२० ।।
transliteration: te tasya kāyaṁ nirbhidya mahākārmukanissṛtāḥ।nipeturdharaṇīṁ bāṇā raktā iva mahoragāḥ ।। 6.91.20 ।।

translations.english: Those arrows released from the great bow of Lakshmana, entered the body of Indrajithand fell on the ground like a huge red serpent.
